notes.title: Arc Defence livestream and chat!
notes.content:
About game:
It's a 2D game in the Tower Defence genre.
However, unlike a classical TD, the enemies here can fight back. Use wisely towers’ upgrades and special abilities to stop waves of foes.

About devs:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37801484/974182e8e2382ad27bb6835c684b3e5d81e37973.jpg

We'll be glad to get feedback fom you! We're a small team and this is our first game
